name: Glutethimide
summary: The drug is a hypnotic sedative that was introduced in 1954, as a "safe" alternative to barbiturates to treat insomnia.

pharmacology.text: Glutethimide (brand names included Doriden, Elrodorm, and Noxyron) is a central nervous system (CNS) depressant drug of the piperidine chemical class, one of many non-barbiturate, "barbiturate-like" GABAergic medications exhibiting general calming, relaxing, or "tranquilizing" properties in addition to relieving anxiety and promoting sleep.

summaryZh: 格魯米特（英語：Glutethimide，也稱為苯乙哌啶酮）是一種戊二醯亞胺衍生物，分子式C13H15NO2，由汽巴精化在1954年開發用於代替巴比妥類藥物治療失眠。

sideEffects.en: It causes drowsiness, poor coordination, next day hangover and anticholinergic effects such as dry mouth and wide pupils. Overdose can cause deep coma, low blood pressure and death, and is hard to treat. Regular use causes dependence, and stopping suddenly can bring severe withdrawal with seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成嗜睡、協調變差、隔天宿醉感，以及口乾、瞳孔放大等抗膽鹼作用。過量可能導致深度昏迷、低血壓甚至死亡，而且很難治療。長期使用會造成依賴，突然停藥可能出現嚴重戒斷並伴隨癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成嗜睡、协调制差、隔天宿醉感，以及口干、瞳孔放大等抗胆碱作用。过量可能导致深度昏迷、低血压甚至死亡，而且很难治疗。长期使用会造成依赖，突然停药可能出现严重戒断并伴随癫痫发作。

fact.en: Glutethimide was launched by Ciba in 1954 as a supposedly safer alternative to barbiturates, but it turned out to be at least as dangerous in overdose and just as habit forming.
fact.zh: 格魯米特由 Ciba 於 1954 年推出，原本號稱是比巴比妥類更安全的替代品，結果它過量時至少同樣危險，也同樣容易成癮。
fact.zhHans: 格鲁米特由 Ciba 于 1954 年推出，原本号称是比巴比妥类更安全的替代品，结果它过量时至少同样危险，也同样容易成瘾。
